division-geometry-type.summary: Resolve type from effective land and territorial flags, then the publisher class.

censtatd-statistic-value.summary: Resolve the output key through the record-pinned field definition and preserve exact decimal strings or publisher status literals.
censtatd-statistic-value.composition: Copy statsRecords.values to attributes.values without numeric coercion.

saanseoi-division-name.summary: Materialise a reviewed archive name for its locale and project the canonical locale into the requested response profile.
saanseoi-division-name.upstream: The archive already contains reviewed names. Bind its upstream build lineage and audits; do not reapply those curations during import.

planning-unit-geometry.summary: Repair source cells, select members of the planning-unit group and union them before canonical area materialisation.

preparation.note: The SHP acquisition branch has a separate coordinate transformation.

planning-unit-geometry.sourceEvidence: Retain original cells independently; canonical assembly consumes the prepared aggregate.
planning-unit-geometry.assembly: Validate geometry, calculate bbox separately and remove embedded bbox from the canonical geometry.
planning-unit-geometry.composition: Project the selected canonical geometry when included by the response profile.

division-response-field.summary: Project one field from the selected canonical Division or geometry record; evaluate visibility for the resolved request profile.

locale.selection: Select canonical locale rows using the resolved request locale mode: none selects no rows, all selects all rows, requested selects exact members. Full defaults to all; other profiles use their configured default locales. Explicit request locales override defaults.

fields.name: String value or null.
fields.nameAlts: Full profile only. Split stored pipe-delimited strings, trim each item and remove empty items; null remains null; an absent result becomes null.
fields.nameRules: Full profile only. Decode stored JSON; an absent result becomes null.

geometry.division: Accept finite Point positions with two or three coordinates, Polygon rings of at least four valid positions, or non-empty MultiPolygon composed of such polygons; invalid shapes become null. Return type and coordinates only.
geometry.divisionArea: Polygon or MultiPolygon type only; other types become null. Preserve the accepted geometry object.
geometry.divisionBoundary: LineString or MultiLineString type only; other types become null. Preserve the accepted geometry object.

division-response-field.hierarchies: Preserve categories, paths and ordering. Retain id, name, class and full_containment when defined; exclude containment_geometry.
division-response-field.divisionCode: Emit only when the canonical divisionCode is truthy.

statistic-response-field.summary: Project Statistics values and metadata without numeric coercion.
statistic-response-field.values: Copy statsRecords.values. Select each field definition by datasetCode, fieldName and record.fieldDefinitionHashes[fieldName].
